info.description: NVIDIA 580.173.02 proprietary driver; CUDA API 13.0; supports Maxwell-through-Ampere GPUs listed in the bundled compatibility table; kernel 5.10.55. Bundled platforms: epyc7002 epyc7003 geminilakenk icelaked r1000nk v1000nk. Includes the matching six-platform DRM provider and DRM/KMS modesetting (modeset=1). Reboot after migration if NVIDIA modules are already loaded.
